title: Soloists & Ensembles
about: The Verbier Festival Academy's Soloists & Ensembles programme runs 11 July to 2 August 2027 in Verbier. Soloists aged 16 to 26, junior students aged 13 to 15 and ensembles apply through getAcceptd by 11 January 2027.
requirements: Soloists aged 16 to 26 on 1 July 2027; junior students 13 to 15
Ensemble members average 22 to 30 on 1 July 2027
card_alt: Card for Soloists & Ensembles at the Verbier Festival Academy, Verbier, Switzerland, deadline 11 Jan 2027. The photo shows Zermatt village below the Matterhorn with a Swiss flag, not Verbier.
